en_summary: Sundar recognizes importance of personalized bots to compete with Muse, Grok Bot, Dot. text:
Sundar recognizes the importance of personalized bots to compete with Muse, Grok Bot, Dot. Says "Agents will operate as a unifying layer across our products, so you will see us extend these agentic experiences beyond search in the Gemini app to Chrome, Android, and our workspace products as well."

My take: I want to better understand what a unifying layer means for the user experience. $GOOG
